what_this_is: The Workshop row for the tell-ais-how-to-act folder: read the rows an AI is told when it first connects. The rows themselves are rows.json, served by the door; this tool only reads them back.

payload.label: Read how AIs are told to act
payload.job: See the standing instructions every AI is given when it first connects, or read one of them whole
payload.description: Answers the rows an AI is told on first connecting: with no id, each row's id, order, whether it is on, where it reaches and its size; with an id, that row whole. It changes nothing; a person switches a row off or adds a rule of their own with their own setting records.

id.description: The row to read whole; leave it out to list the rows
